name: Deleting Heart
source:
"Hello!
Life is complicated, isn't it? Pity there isn't another option. So... I'm going to play this dating game and try to forget for a while.
Forget with me?"

Deleting Heart is a full-length visual novel about one woman seeking escapism from her messy life, and facing that life when escapism betrays her.

[From [url=https://excellentjab.itch.io/deleting-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你好！

生活很复杂，对吧？真可惜，除此之外别无选择。所以……我打算玩这款恋爱游戏，暂时忘掉一切。

和我一起忘掉烦恼，好吗？”

《Deleting Heart》是一部完整篇幅的视觉小说，讲述一位女性试图逃避一团乱麻的生活，却在逃避背叛她时不得不重新面对现实。

[摘自[url=https://excellentjab.itch.io/deleting-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
